FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
16.01.2024
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Senior Research Fellow
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Senior Research Fellow in a
consultancy project with M/s Curetech Skincare on ‘Development of Molecules of Interest for
Cosmetic and Hair Application’ sanctioned to Dr Indu Pal Kaur, Professor of Pharmaceutics at
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS).
Applications along with Curriculum vitae may be sent by email to dripkpu@gmail.com latest by
11:00 AM on 27th January 2024.
Eligible candidates are invited to appear for a Walk-in-interview on Monday 29th January
2024 at 3:00 p.m. in the Seminar Hall, Extension building, UIPS, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
No separate interview letters will be issued.
No TA/DA will be provided to the candidates.
Fellowship: Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be @ Rs 35,000/- p.m (fixed)
The duration of the fellowship is 2 years but initially the appointment will be for 6 months.
Essential Qualification:
1. B.Pharmacy and M.Pharmacy (preferably Pharmaceutics) with minimum 55% marks
(50% in case of SC/ST/PH)
2. GATE/GPAT/PU entrance test for Ph.D. must be qualified.
Desirable Qualification:
Previous research or industrial experience.
Eligible candidates are advised to bring original testimonials at the time of interview.
Sd/-
Dr Indu Pal Kaur
Professor of Pharmaceutics
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS)
Panjab University, Sector 14
Chandigarh, 160014
Email id: dripkpu@gmail.com
Alternative email id: indupalkaur@pu.ac.in
